flow/Bouncing in place: Was a tucked squat-jump (airborne knees 144°, 65° dip, pelvis travelling 20 cm). Now a small bounce: long legs in the air, toes hanging, a soft 30° dip.
flow/Arm sweeps with knee dip: The bottom was a squat (knees 84°, trunk only level). Now a hip fold with a knee dip, head toward the floor, hands behind the shins; at the top the hips push forward so the body bows.
flow/Punching rotations: One leg was straight because the feet were squared to the world, not the body. Now a horse stance; the retracting fist comes to the ribs and the crossover is a chambered guard.
flow/Dynamic lateral reaches: The resting hand floated 25 cm off the body and the shoulders stayed level. Now the hand sits on the hip crest with the elbow out and the near shoulder drops with the bend.
flow/Cross-body knee drives: The trunk turned away from the lifted knee and the standing knee was bent to 134°. Now the opposite elbow comes down to the knee, the trunk turns toward it and the standing leg is straight.
flow/Chest opener swings: The swing is horizontal, and the old camera saw it edge-on (arms shrank to 26% as they crossed). Now seen 3/4 from slightly above.
flow/Single-leg hip circles: Hands on hips were straight arms at the sides. Now elbows out, a 3/4 front view so both legs' side stations read, and the stations pulled inside real hip range.
flow/Bent rotation sweeps: The planted hand went 3.5 cm under the floor and slid 35 cm between positions; the far foot lifted. Now it stays planted and the crossover no longer stops dead.
flow/Cat-cows: Elbows bent in cow because the shoulders were dragged back off the hands. Now arms straight and vertical all cycle (your decision), with the arch as deep as the round.
flow/Cobra press-ups: Started half-raised with the elbows pointing down and out and one knee floating. Now starts flat, elbows fold back along the ribs, both legs rest on the floor, and the top stops short of end range.
flow/Pedaling down dog: Hands missed the floor by 5 cm and both legs looked the same. Now a true inverted V with one knee bent and that heel lifted, alternating.
flow/Thread the needle: The support arm was bent in every frame and the shoulder never dropped. Now it is straight in the reach, the chest and head go down in the thread, and the arm passes behind the planted hand.
flow/90/90 with a fold: The back leg's 90° bend lay in the floor plane and read as a straight leg. Camera raised to 30° so the Z shows; upright hands rest on the thighs.
daily/Deep squats: Your decision: just below parallel, heels down. The standing arms used to strain toward the bottom position's hand target (30 cm out of reach); now they swing forward as a counterweight. Cue text updated.
daily/Reverse lunges: The hips slid 24° off the body's own axis, tipping the front shin 12°. Now the rear foot plants on its ball at full step length, then the hips drop; front shin vertical.
daily/Dead bug: Unchanged. It passed the rubric as shipped.
daily/Glute bridge: Feet squared to the body so the shins are vertical at the top (they leaned 21°).
daily/Side-lying clamshell: Was a face-down body seen from an angle, with the opening knee hidden. Now genuinely side-lying (new root roll): hips stacked, heels together, top knee opening toward you, top hand on the floor.
daily/Bird dog: Hands were 21 cm off the shoulder line and the reaching elbow bent to 156°. Now hands under shoulders, a low forward slide, straight reach at shoulder height.
daily/Prone Y-T-W raise: Side-on, the three letters were one line. Now two cameras: the setup preview stays side-on so face-down reads, and the work phase is seen from above, on a mat, so each letter reads.
daily/Side plank: Was a face-down body with level hips. Now a straight body rolled onto its side: elbow under shoulder, hips and feet stacked. Your decision: it holds the line, with a breath and no sag.
daily/Plank hold: Arms were bent in mid-air, neither forearm nor straight-arm. Your decision: forearm plank. Elbows under shoulders, forearms on the floor. Spoken setup line updated and re-recorded.
daily/Dumbbell bent-over row: Your decision: torso 45° from the floor (it was 28°). Arms hang straight at the bottom; the camera moved off pure profile so both arms and both dumbbells show.
daily/Bench dips: Squared to the bench (the right elbow flared 13 cm out). Straight arms at the top; the bottom stops 3 cm short of parallel as a margin on the AC-joint rule.
daily/Dumbbell farmer hold: Elbows were bent to 155°. Arms now hang dead straight and the dumbbells sit in the fist, 7 cm below the hip joint.
daily/Standing posture reset: Was a forward lean on a 5 s cycle. Now three breaths in the 30 s: a 4 s inhale opening into a rib flare, a 6 s exhale settling the ribs over the pelvis. The breath tone follows the same 4 and 6.
strength/Goblet squat: Hips stopped 4 cm above the knees and the elbows sat outside them. Now hips to knee height, knees out over the toes, elbows inside, bell on the sternum.
strength/Neutral-grip DB floor press: The elbows were out in a T (86°) and hovered 13 cm off the floor, with the forearms 45° off vertical. Now 45° from the trunk, resting on the floor, wrists over elbows all the way up.
strength/Single-arm DB row: The bench leg's knee was folded backwards (shin toward the head). Now it kneels; the rowing forearm stays vertical and the elbow finishes up and back by the hip.
strength/Romanian deadlift: Hands missed their targets by 9 cm mid-rep and the filled plates covered the hips and knees. Now the bar is in the fist and tracks the legs to just below the knee from a 53° hinge, arms 5° back of plumb, plates as rings.
strength/Face pull: From 3/4 front the finish read as a salute (a forearm shrank to 4%). Now seen from behind and to one side: elbows flare high and wide, hands finish beside the head, no lean-back.
strength/Trap-bar deadlift: Filled plates covered the whole lower body. Now a frame around the body with ring plates on the floor at the bottom, handles in the fist, arms 10° back of plumb.
strength/Split squat: The hips slid 10 cm back on the way down and one arm was hidden. Now the hips drop straight down with the back knee hovering under the hip.
strength/Chest-supported row: Squared to the bench; both arms hang straight at the bottom (the right was bent to 155°) and the elbows stay close.
strength/Neutral-grip lat pulldown: The start was a bent-arm diamond and the trunk rocked 12°. Now a full reach to the pulley, one constant lean, and a side view so the cable runs in front of the face.
strength/Band pull-apart: In near-profile the pull happened in depth and the arms seemed to fold into the chest. Now it faces you, so the band stretches across the screen with straight arms.
strength/Side plank: Same rebuild as Daily 13: a real side plank, held.
